systems.system: Sistema de Informação Policial da África Ocidental (SIPAO)
systems.owner: not stated; the new service was inaugurated with the Polícia Judiciária's National Director, the Guarda Nacional's Commander and a representative of the Secretary of State for Public Order present
systems.tiers: a new SIPAO service beside the Guarda Nacional command (ex-QG) in Bissau; described as a centre for collecting and processing information where all police forces work and share information, with sharing nationally and internationally over the INTERPOL channel

note: States that a new SIPAO service was inaugurated on a Wednesday (the dispatch is dated 2024-08-22) beside the Guarda Nacional command in Bissau, and describes it as sharing and cross-checking criminal data between the country's police forces and abroad; nothing on stations entering reports or cases, so no fact.
